It captures each child's world transform, detaches the children with `setParent(child, null)`, writes the captured transform back into each child's position, rotation and scale, and then calls `removeFromScene` on the mesh. Children are never re-added, so they keep their one entry in `scene.meshes`.

I could not compile or run this, since the library isn't on the machine. I was not sure of these points:

- **Removal side effects:** I don't know whether `removeFromScene` disposes GPU resources or touches `children`.
